title: Number Crunching
prompt:
Write three functions for common numeric operations:

**Requirements:**
1. `circle_area(radius)` -- returns the area of a circle using `math.pi`
2. `clamp(value, low, high)` -- returns value constrained between low and high
3. `is_even(n)` -- returns `True` if n is divisible by 2
hints: Import math for pi: import math
max(low, min(value, high)) is a common clamp pattern
The modulo operator % gives the remainder: n % 2

solution.py.name: circle_area
solution.py.description: Define a circle_area function that accepts a radius parameter

solution.py.name: clamp
solution.py.description: Define a clamp function that accepts value, low, and high parameters

solution.py.name: is_even
solution.py.description: Define an is_even function that accepts an n parameter
